parsed.summary: The message shows classic phishing indicators: sender and reply-to mismatch, a deceptive display name, failed SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, and a login URL that differs from the displayed destination. The recipient reported clicking the link and noticing the sign-in page address changed, but they did not enter any information, so credential compromise is not confirmed.
